completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Parks and Trees (Designated Management Body — Gardens by the Bay) Notification 2019 and comes into operation on 22 June 2019.
2. Gardens by the Bay (UEN 201132829N) is designated as a management body for the land specified in the Schedule.
